Hey — this is a fairly common Outlook -> Google forwarding issue when TZ metadata is omitted or when ICS uses a floating time. Quick options:

1) Create a fresh Google Calendar event for Thu May 13, 10:00 AM PDT and invite the customer emails directly. Google will translate to their local zones reliably.
2) Export an ICS from Google (it will include proper TZID blocks) and attach that to your reply if you prefer sending an attachment.
3) Send the time in UTC in your message (e.g., 2026-05-13T17:00:00Z) and include a Calendar link — this avoids DST ambiguity.

I'll create a new event in Google and send from our account if you want me to. We should also include the explicit timezone string in the email subject (e.g., "10:00 AM PDT / 1:00 PM EDT") to reduce confusion.
